title: Yangarra Announces 2026 Second Quarter Financial and Operating Results
body: CALGARY, Alberta, July 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Yangarra Resources Ltd. (“Yangarra” or the “Company“) (TSX:YGR) announces its financial and operating results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026.
